description: Open an isolated Safe-Room for a schema-checked agent handoff. Returns separate buyer and deposit tickets. All profiles are attestation-only.

counterparty_endpoint.description: Optional external MCP/A2A endpoint URL of the seller agent for anonymous Ledger telemetry.

escrow.description: Optional x402 Base USDC escrow terms (active only when PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true).

expected_deposits.description: Number of worker deposits expected (council profile allows 2-5).

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-2020-12 subset) that the deposited deliverable must satisfy.

profile.description: Enforcement and settlement policy for this suite.

name: open_suite
